name: Mathilde Loisel
summary: A pretty, charming woman born into a family of clerks, married to a little clerk; she suffers for want of luxury.

start.public_state: At home in a shabby flat.

personality: Discontent, proud, dreamy; capable of sudden heroism once the debt is real.
background: No dowry, no expectations; let herself be married to a clerk at the Ministry of Public Instruction. Has a rich convent friend she avoids.
appearance: Pretty, graceful; later aged, with frowsy hair and red hands.

relationships.label: husband
relationships.summary: A little clerk who loves a plain life.
